prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return solution.rs with the public function at module scope.
Required API: pub fn label_overlay(input: &str) -> Option<String>
Behavior: Parse base;operations. Base is comma-separated unique key=value labels; operations are set:key=value or unset:key and apply in order. Keys use ASCII [a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*. Values are non-empty printable ASCII without comma or semicolon. Return final labels sorted by key, or invalid input.
Visible example: a=one,b=two;unset:a,set:b=three,set:c=four returns b=three,c=four.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: use std::collections::BTreeMap;fn key(s:&str)->bool{let p:Vec<_>=s.split('-').collect();!s.is_empty()&&s.as_bytes()[0].is_ascii_lowercase()&&p.iter().all(|x|!x.is_empty()&&x.bytes().all(|c|c.is_ascii_lowercase()||c.is_ascii_digit()))}fn val(s:&str)->bool{!s.is_empty()&&s.bytes().all(|c|(32..=126).contains(&c)&&c!=b','&&c!=b';')}pub fn label_overlay(s:&str)->Option<String>{if s.matches(';').count()!=1{return None}let(base,ops)=s.split_once(';')?;let mut d=BTreeMap::new();if !base.is_empty(){for r in base.split(','){let(k,v)=r.split_once('=')?;if !key(k)||!val(v)||d.insert(k,v).is_some(){return None}}}if !ops.is_empty(){for op in ops.split(','){if let Some(x)=op.strip_prefix("set:"){let(k,v)=x.split_once('=')?;if !key(k)||!val(v){return None}d.insert(k,v);}else if let Some(k)=op.strip_prefix("unset:"){if !key(k){return None}d.remove(k);}else{return None}}}Some(d.into_iter().map(|x|x.0.to_string()+"="+x.1).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(","))}
